definitions.explanation: A country that exports goods, resources, or products to other countries, especially one known for a particular export.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{輸出国|ゆしゅつこく}だ。
⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧な⟦{石油|せきゆ}→石油：01448_sekiyu⟧{輸出国|ゆしゅつこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The major oil-exporting countries held a conference.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{農産物|のうさんぶつ}→農産物：14360_nousanbutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{輸出国|ゆしゅつこく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{輸入国|ゆにゅうこく}→輸入国：25665_yunyuukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧⟦{摩擦|まさつ}→摩擦：00271_masatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きている→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: In this region, trade friction has arisen between agricultural exporting and importing countries.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{輸出|ゆしゅつ}→輸出：02094_yushutsu⟧ (export) and {国|こく} (country). The {国|こく} suffix is productive for forming country-type labels: ⟦{先進国|せんしんこく}→先進国：11624_senshinkoku⟧ (developed country), ⟦{途上国|とじょうこく}→途上国：14424_tojoukoku⟧ (developing country).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{石油|せきゆ}→石油：01448_sekiyu⟧{輸出国|ゆしゅつこく}: oil-exporting country
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{輸出国|ゆしゅつこく}: the largest exporter
- {輸出国|ゆしゅつこく}⟦{機構|きこう}→機構：02784_kikou⟧: organization of exporting countries (as in OPEC)
- ⟦{純|じゅん}→純〜：28361_jun⟧{輸出国|ゆしゅつこく}: net exporter

SIMILAR/RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{輸入国|ゆにゅうこく}→輸入国：25665_yunyuukoku⟧: importing country — the counterpart
- {貿易国|ぼうえきこく}: trading nation — broader term covering both import and export
- ⟦{輸出|ゆしゅつ}→輸出：02094_yushutsu⟧: export (the act itself)
